lessons.title: Food I like
objectives: Use like, love, and do not like with food nouns.
Use food preferences in one short, clear everyday exchange.

content_sections.title: Language focus
content_sections.body: In lesson 16: food preferences, notice this model: I like rice, but I do not like very sweet tea. Keep the word order short and make the meaning clear.
